prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original demo character reference image for testing a photo-to-voxel-character builder. Create ONE full-body FRONT VIEW of an original friendly block-proportioned explorer, rendered as a clean high-quality matte 3D toy character. Short dark brown blocky hair, warm tan skin, simple friendly dark eyes, teal jacket with a bright orange neck scarf and small orange zipper, dark navy trousers, tan boots. Straight simple humanoid silhouette with head about one quarter of total height, rectangular torso, two straight separate arms and two separate legs. Neutral standing pose, arms relaxed straight down with a small gap from torso, feet apart just enough to see both legs. Character looks directly at camera, both sides of face and body symmetric. Orthographic camera at body center, straight front with no yaw or tilt, no perspective distortion. Full body from top of hair to bottom of boots completely in frame, centered, generous even margin, portrait composition about 1024 by 1536. Plain solid very light gray background, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadow or floor line, flat easy-to-sample colors, minimal texture. No accessories held, no bag, no weapons, no text, no watermark, no logos, no other people, no additional views. The face and torso MUST point directly toward the viewer. This is a reference photograph-style render, NOT a UV skin atlas.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: matching character turnaround reference for testing photo uploads. The attached image is the CHARACTER IDENTITY AND STYLE REFERENCE. Create a SINGLE new camera view of this exact original matte 3D explorer toy character. Preserve the same dark brown blocky hairstyle, warm tan skin, teal hooded zip jacket, bright orange scarf, orange zipper, dark navy cargo trousers and cuffs, and tan boots with brown straps/soles; keep identical face, proportions, limb lengths, full-body standing pose, camera height, scale, soft studio lighting and plain very light gray backdrop. Neutral standing pose with relaxed arms and separate feet. Orthographic full body, all hair and boots visible with margin, portrait 1024 by 1536. Do not invent a backpack, weapons, logos, text or extra views. Do not make a sheet. Output is the BACK VIEW: rotate the camera exactly 180 degrees around the same stationary character so we see only its back. Back of hair, back of teal hood and jacket, backs of navy trousers, heels of boots. The face, eyes, scarf triangle, zipper and front pockets must not appear on the back. Keep the jacket back simple teal with its hood at the neck. Single straight rear view, no three-quarter angle.
